definitions.rising: Heat履歴2点以上・6時間以上のspanが揃った記事を対象に、直近24時間のHeat上昇率で算出。
definitions.persistent_hot: Heat履歴3点以上・48時間以上のspanが揃った記事を対象に、各時点で上位10%を80%以上維持した記事。

latest.summary: A critical flaw in MongoDB Server allows an unauthenticated attacker to send two requests that trigger a crash on the database server. The crash occurs only if that server is later chosen to take over as the main server while it still lacks some recent changes. MongoDB, the company that makes the database, released fixed versions earlier this week. The affected servers are members of a replica

latest.summary: A threat actor using stolen GitHub credentials has pushed a credential-stealing payload into tens of thousands of repositories since November 10. In more than 1,800 of them, the malware ran and shipped GitHub Actions secrets and cloud credentials to the attacker. Aikido spotted the campaign and named it wfx-loot. The name comes from the attacker’s own labels, “wfx” for the malware and “loot” for what it steals. Aikido counted 4,837 compromised accounts opening probe pull … More → The post Check your GitHub repos: A secret stealer hit tens of thousands of them appeared first on Help Net Security .
